k:梗.mnemonic: A tree (木) that lets its buds grow late (更): by the time they open, the season is over and each flower stem has closed up. Its branches are bare for the most part. For the most part (close up, flower stem).
k:梗.hint: A tree that buds too late.

k:穀.mnemonic: Grain (禾) still wrapped in its husk (殻): whole sacks of wheat, rice and oats straight from the field, before any milling. Cereal (grain, cereals).

k:襟.mnemonic: A cloak (衤) with a prohibition (禁) stitched on it: 'do not open'. The one part buttoned that tight, right up under the chin, is the collar. Collar (neck, lapel, one's inner feelings).

k:鉛.mnemonic: Someone promises to give (呉) you gold (金), but the bar handed over is dull, grey and far too heavy. You have been given lead. Lead.
k:鉛.hint: Promised gold, handed a grey bar.

k:喝.mnemonic: A street vendor yells the same phrase (句) all day long: 'Delicious (旨)! Delicious!' By evening his voice has cracked to a rasp. Hoarse (scold).

k:厄.mnemonic: You shelter under an overhang (厂) and it drops on you like a giant stamp (卩), flattening you. Of all the cliffs to pick. Unlucky (misfortune, bad luck, disaster).

k:腎.mnemonic: A retainer (臣) must match his lord cup for cup all month (月), and also (又) the next. The organ that filters every drop and bears the load is his kidney. Kidney.

k:剰.mnemonic: You ordered one knife (刂) and ten thousand (万) arrived. One is in use and the rest sit in crates with nothing to cut. Surplus (besides).

k:枢.mnemonic: A crate (匚) pinned to a tree (木) so that it swings open and shut like a door. Everything turns on that one pin. Hinge (pivot, door, center of things).
k:枢.hint: A crate swinging on one pin.

k:勅.mnemonic: A notice nailed to a tree (木) carries the power (力) to command all of Asia (亜). Nobody may ignore it, because the emperor himself wrote it. Imperial order.
k:勅.hint: The notice no one may ignore.

k:粘.mnemonic: A fortune-telling (占) session done with cooked rice (米): the teller throws a handful at the wall and reads whatever clings there. All of it does. Sticky (glutinous, greasy, persevere).
k:粘.hint: Reading rice thrown at a wall.

k:吟.mnemonic: The poet's mouth (口) opens and whatever is happening right now (今) comes out as a chanted line of verse, made up on the spot. Versify (singing, recital).

k:裾.mnemonic: The part of a cloak (衤) where the dust and mud reside (居): the very bottom edge that trails along the ground. Cuff (hem, foot of mountain).
k:裾.hint: Where the mud lives on a cloak.

k:庶.mnemonic: Under a market canopy (广), plain folk crowd around the cooking flames (灬) and share one pot. No lords here, just everybody else. Commoner (all, whole, entire).

k:髄.mnemonic: Follow the path (辶) into a skeleton (骨) to see what the bones have (有) inside: a soft core running down the middle of each. Marrow (pith, essence).

k:懇.mnemonic: A hound (犭) and a badger (豸), each stubborn (艮) and all claw (爪), finally sit down and share a meal. Under the fur each has a warm heart (心) and likes company. Sociable (kind, courteous, hospitable).

k:璃.mnemonic: The king (王) peers into a pit (凵) and finds a paw print (禸) set in blue stone so smooth that he sees his own face in it. Glassy (lapis lazuli).
k:璃.hint: A paw print in mirror-smooth stone.

k:勃.mnemonic: A child (子) dozes with his forehead (冖) on the desk beside his co- (協) worker. The bell rings and both shoot upright in the same instant. Suddenness (rise).

k:塀.mnemonic: Twenty (廾) posts exist (在) in a row around the yard, with a flag (尸) on the corner one to mark whose land it is. Boards between them make it solid. Fence (wall).
k:塀.hint: Twenty posts and a corner flag.

k:褒.mnemonic: The leader (亻) is called to the capital (京) and draped in a splendid garment (衣) of honour before the whole court for his good work. Praise (extol).
k:褒.hint: A robe of honour at court.

k:扶.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) reach out to a big (大) person (人) who has stumbled and hold him up by the arm until he is steady again. Aid (help, assist).
k:扶.hint: A steadying hand on the arm.

k:曖.mnemonic: The day (日) you fall in love (愛), the sun goes hazy and nothing else will come into focus. Does she feel the same? Impossible to tell. Unclear (dark, not clear).
k:曖.hint: A hazy sun for the lovestruck.

k:癒.mnemonic: A month (月) in the sickbed (疒) after the surgeon's knife (刂). Then one morning the patient puts on his hat (𠆢) and walks out with a light heart (心). Healing (cure).
k:癒.hint: The patient puts his hat on.

k:慌.mnemonic: You come home to find your room laid waste (荒), drawers tipped everywhere. Your heartbeat (忄) races and you spin in circles, not knowing what to check first. Disconcerted (be confused, lose one's head).
k:慌.hint: Racing pulse in a wrecked room.

k:潰.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) lands on everything precious (貴) you own: the vase, the piano, the car, all flattened under the weight of water. Crush (smash, break, dissipate).

k:肖.mnemonic: A portrait painter works for a month (月), then adds one last sparkle (⺌) to the eyes. Now the canvas looks exactly like the sitter. Resemblance.
k:肖.hint: The final glint in a portrait.

k:奔.mnemonic: A big (大) man with a thousand (千) errands and only twenty (廾) minutes to do them: arms flung wide, he tears down the street. Dash (run, bustle).

k:窃.mnemonic: At night a thief has cut (切) a neat hole (穴) in the wall. He slips through it without a sound and takes what he likes. Stealth (steal, secret, private).
k:窃.hint: A hole cut quietly at night.

k:綻.mnemonic: One loose thread (糸) will determine (定) the fate of the whole seam: tug it and the stitching opens up all the way down. Be rent (ripped, unravel, run).
k:綻.hint: One loose strand, one open seam.

k:窒.mnemonic: The only hole (穴) letting air into the room (室) gets stuffed with a rag. Nothing can pass in or out, and it grows hard to breathe. Plug up (obstruct).
k:窒.hint: A rag in the only air hole.
